minutes.headline: Planning Board approved Tritown Landing senior-housing change and a scenic-road tree removal at 1054 Northfield Road
minutes.summary: The board reorganized with new officers and committee appointments. It approved tree and stone wall removal on a scenic road with replanting conditions, and approved a site plan modification at Tritown Landing for one age-restricted building. It also heard a permitting guidebook presentation, reviewed a marijuana survey, and discussed Flat Hill drainage enforcement.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved a site plan modification at Tritown Landing, 437 Young's Road, for an age-restricted senior-housing building, with added conditions.
The board approved removing trees and stone wall on a scenic road at 1054 Northfield Road, on condition of replanting at least 11 sugar maples and oaks.
Staff will write up the Tritown Landing conditions: a 55+ age restriction, a clear fire lane, snow management, fire lane signage and dark-sky lighting.
The board voted to authorize the chair to sign decisions in place of the full board.
The marijuana survey will go ahead with numerical limits added to two questions, and the next meeting is a marijuana listening session on the 25th.

why_it_matters: The Tritown Landing approval puts a 55+ age restriction in the permit conditions, which bears on who can live in the new building and on neighbors' concerns about fire access, snow and lighting.
The marijuana survey and listening session are the board's way of gathering resident views before any local rules are drafted, so residents can weigh in there.
watch_next: Marijuana listening session at the next Planning Board meeting on the 25th.
Staff's written Tritown Landing decision with the added conditions, including the 55+ age restriction.
